name: Collateral Matching Criteria 6
definition: Compares information related to both sides of a collateral.

UncollateralisedFlag.name: Uncollateralised Flag
UncollateralisedFlag.definition: Specifies whether the values defined as true/false indicator are matching or not.

NetExposureCollateralisationIndicator.name: Net Exposure Collateralisation Indicator
NetExposureCollateralisationIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the values defined as true/false indicator are matching or not.

CollateralValueDate.name: Collateral Value Date
CollateralValueDate.definition: Specifies whether the values defined as active or historic currency and amount are matching or not.

AssetType.name: Asset Type
AssetType.definition: Specifies whether the information on the component type is matching or not.

BasketIdentifier.name: Basket Identifier
BasketIdentifier.definition: Specifies whether the values defined as security identification are matching or not.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
